name: Sejm
notes: 460 seats; members of the 10th term who are active. Clubs as the Sejm names them.

name: Senat
notes: 100 seats, one to four per district, elected 15 October 2023. Who sits and their election committee are from the Polish Wikipedia list of the senators of the 11th term (updated for by-elections and mandates that ended), because the Senate's own list could not be read; a secondary source. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
